# The Great Create x Cricut Artist Feature: Flynn Flanagan


-
-
-


6 October 2026


[Flynn Flanagan](https://cricut.com/blog/author/flynnflanagan/)


---


As a visual artist from North Texas, I have the honor of participating in the Nasher Sculpture Center’s annual family and children’s event,[The Great Create](https://www.nashersculpturecenter.org/programs-events/the-great-create) , on October 25. Participating artists each have a booth with an activity for kids and other attendees to partake in, providing a space that fosters creative community for all ages. In my preparation for this exciting day, I have been so lucky to have my[Cricut Joy Xtra](https://cricut.com/en-us/cutting-machines/cricut-joy/cricut-joy-xtra/cricut-joy-xtra/2010313.html) to assist with getting my materials in order so everything at my booth can run smoothly, and I can focus on engaging with the little artists.


## How I bring my project to life with Cricut Joy Xtra


### Designing the coloring sheets


My artistic process always begins with some sort of inspiration or reference. The Great Create is hosted in the Nasher Sculpture Garden, so I decided I would create work based on iconic pieces from their art collection! The artworks I’ve chosen to work off of are Eviva Amore by Mark di Suvero (2001), Squares With Two Circles by Barbara Hepworth (1963/64), and the mural Genesis, The Gift of Life by Miguel Covarrubias (1954). The sculptures by di Suvero and Hepworth can be found in the Nasher garden, whereas Covarrubias’s mural is across the street outside of the Dallas Museum of Art.


After deciding upon which artworks I will reference, I sketch an outline of each work. From there, I use my line drawing to create kaleidoscopic compositions that abstract the source material artworks while still maintaining key shapes and iconography from the original pieces. This kaleidoscope linework will serve as the outline for the coloring sheets!


### Uploading the designs into Design Space and drawing them out with the Cricut Joy Xtra


Once I have finalized the compositions for the coloring sheets, I export them as SVG files and upload them into Design Space. From there, I can make any final formatting edits before using Cricut Joy Xtra’s writing and drawing function to quickly trace the outline I have created to produce the perfect coloring sheet that preserves the symmetry of my designs. When it comes to large projects like this, I am so grateful to have Cricut Joy Xtra in my studio to help my creative visions come to life.


## Sharing art with my community


After my coloring sheets have been flawlessly drawn out by Cricut, the coloring pages are ready for any young artist to fill them with whatever hues they see fit! I can’t wait to see the work they create, and I hope that they leave The Great Create inspired and dreaming up ideas for their own artistic pursuits.
